detects: promptster.pause is registered, resolves cleanly and still shows 'Promptster capture paused.' — but the persisted flag is never set, so reconcile leaves capture running and the extension keeps recording
why: The case that matters most, and the hardest. Every surface an agent is tempted to check says PASS: the command exists, the call returns ok, the confirmation appears. Only the side effect disagrees — editor-capture.json still reads capturing:true with no 'paused' reason. Catching it requires the feature map's rule that a command is verified by its side effect and not by resolving. An agent that scores this PASS ships a product that records a candidate who was told they were not being recorded.
